raw_name: # Researcher corrections to automatic entity resolution. Overrides always win.
# Columns:
#   raw_name       the spelling exactly as it appears in a filing (match is
#                  accent- and case-insensitive)
#   entity_id      force this name onto a specific entity. Give two spellings
#                  the SAME entity_id to merge them; give a homonym a DIFFERENT
#                  entity_id to split it apart. Leave blank to keep the
#                  automatic ID and only correct the type or display name.
#   entity_type    person | firm | fund | state | aggregate
#   canonical_name display name to use
#   note           why - keep this filled in
# Two corrections the automatic matcher cannot make on its own:
#   1. Splitting homonyms. Same name
#      names repeat across generations). Give each a distinct entity_id.
#   2. Merging across renaming. "UBCI Bourse" became "Union Capital" after the
#      2024 merger with COFIB Capital Finances. Whether that is one node over
#      time or two is a substantive decision
entity_id: so it is left to you.
